findings.reason: the DAG orders nodes the queue dispatches, and a section that consumes §14/§15's landed shim behaviour must be held behind them or it launches ungated; this is the same defect an earlier round fixed for s15 and s12.
findings.text: `s16` is declared `implementable` (plan.html:141) and rewritten into the same scheduler-shim and fence path §14 and §15 landed, yet it appears in no `plan-section-depends-on` entry, so a batch dispatch gives the one node that extends the shim no upstream gate at all

findings.reason: `reckon/roadmap.py:564` sizes remaining effort as `_effort_hours(plan) * (1 - progress)`, so the plan understates its own remaining work by a whole section's share, the same understatement an earlier round corrected for s15.
findings.text: `plan-effort-hours` is 18.5 but the sixteen declared sections sum to 20.0, and the shortfall is exactly s16's 1.5, which was added today without the scalar being raised

findings.reason: the build contract requires a worker to confirm a recorded defect still reproduces and quote the reproduction, and a section whose incident has no citable record leaves the worker to reconstruct the trigger from prose and cannot show its red arm is the measured failure.
findings.text: the Why names "a nova worker" and "three jobs to a GPU node" with no run id, job id or stream, while every sibling Why in this plan cites the artifact it rests on (§12's jobs 1326129/1326150/1326382, §14's jobs 1327697/1327709, §15's run r-20261119T181303457799 and jobs 1332134/1332191/1332272), so the negative control's premise — that at the base revision the job is submitted unwrapped — rests on no record a worker can open

findings.reason: an unnamed venue lets the worker run a namespace-spawning gate on the fleet node, which the fleet rule forbids, and without the importer arm the section carries no regression-surface measure, so its gate proves less than its siblings' gates.
findings.text: §16's done-when requires a test that builds a fenced worker launch and submits a job, which needs a partition the way §15's equivalent test does, yet it names no venue and no "importers add no failure against the base" arm, where every sibling that launches a fence names `all_debug`

findings.reason: the lifecycle record dates itself a day before its own newest content, and `reckon/doccheck.py:323` measures plan staleness from that field, so the plan reads one day older than it is.
findings.text: `plan-modified` reads 2026-11-20 while the plan now carries §16 describing a 21 November incident and `plan-version` 36, the edit having landed in commit 573fbcc761 on 21 November

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §16's only cross-references are to §14 (plan.html:131) and §15 (plan.html:137), both of which exist as headings, and the test path it names is a file the node creates rather than an anchor that must resolve now.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §16's done-when (plan.html:144) names no compute venue and no importer arm, unlike every sibling that builds a fenced launch.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §16 names no scratch or node-local path; its evidence is the run-directory gate log the harness writes by default, and nothing in the section routes evidence anywhere that does not survive the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §16's heading carries the `§16` label like its siblings, and neither its prose nor its test name carries a ticket number, version tag or plan label.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §16's Why (plan.html:142) states a measured incident with no run id, job ids or stream, so its root cause is asserted rather than cited, though the mechanism it names is real: `reckon/nested_launch.py:956` returns the caller's argv unchanged when `RECKON_WORKER_FENCE` is absent, and `job_fence` at `reckon/nested_launch.py:584` documents "no recipe means the worker itself ran unfenced".
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §16 carries one deliverable, that a submission from inside a fence runs fenced or is refused, with the refusal naming the run.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's `plan-effort-hours` (plan.html:13) is 18.5 while the declared sections sum to 20.0, and `s16` appears in `plan-section-declarations` (plan.html:23) but in no `plan-section-depends-on` entry (plan.html:24).
